__I. Loading Libraries__
```{r, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

library(plotly)
```

__II. Using the NYC Restaurant Inspection results from the `p8105.datasets` package.__ 
```{r}
data("rest_inspec")

rest_clean =  rest_inspec |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    camis = as.character(camis),
    across(where(is.character), str_trim),
    across(where(is.character), ~ replace(.x, .x %in% c("NKA", "NA", ""), NA)),
    building = na_if(building, "0"),
    boro = na_if(boro, "0"),
    latitude = na_if(latitude, 0), 
    longitude = na_if(longitude, 0),
    inspection_date = replace(inspection_date, lubridate::year(inspection_date) == 1900, NA),
    record_date = replace(record_date, lubridate::year(record_date) == 1900, NA), 
    grade_date = replace(grade_date, lubridate::year(grade_date) == 1900, NA)
  )
```

__III. Distribution of inspection scores by borough (higher score = more violations)__

```{r}
rest_clean |>
  select(camis, dba, boro, zipcode, cuisine_description,
         inspection_date, inspection_type, score, grade) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(!is.na(score)) |>
  filter(!is.na(boro)) |>
  mutate(
    boro = fct_reorder(boro, score)
  ) |>
  plot_ly(y = ~score, color = ~boro, type = "box", colors = "viridis")
```

__IV. Longitude vs latitude, with color indicating average scores (higher score = more violations) at initial cycle inspection__

```{r, message = FALSE}
rest_clean |>
  filter(inspection_type == "Cycle Inspection / Initial Inspection") |>
  drop_na(score, latitude, longitude) |>
  distinct(camis, dba, inspection_date, latitude, longitude, score) |>
  group_by(camis, dba, latitude, longitude) |>
  summarise(
    avg_score = mean(score),
    n_inspections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c(dba, "\nAverage Score:", round(avg_score, 2), "\nInspections", n_inspections)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude, y = ~latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", text = ~text_label,
    color = ~avg_score, marker = list(size = 3), alpha = 0.5, colors = "viridis"
  )
  
  
```


__V. Top 20 Violation Codes in 2019__
```{r}
rest_clean |>
  filter(lubridate::year(inspection_date) == 2019) |>
  drop_na(violation_code) |>
  count(violation_code, violation_description) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 20) |>
  mutate(
    violation_code = fct_reorder(violation_code, n),
    text_label = str_c(str_trunc(violation_description, 100), "\nCount:", n)
  ) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~violation_code, y = ~n, color = ~violation_code, text = ~text_label, type = "bar", colors = "viridis")
```
